status.description:
A succinct status representing the completion status of the dataset preparation step.
The possible values are:
- 'COMPLETE': Indicates that the dataset preparation was successfully completed.
- 'FAILED': Indicates that the dataset preparation step encountered an error or was unsuccessful.

message.description:
A more detailed message that explains the {@link status}.
When the {@link status} is `COMPLETE`, this message provides confirmation of successful completion.
When the {@link status} is `FAILED`, this message will provide details of the failure, including
any potential prescriptive measures or actions to take to resolve the issue.

For example: "Dataset preparation completed successfully."
For example: "Failed to prepare dataset due to missing values in the input data. Please ensure all required fields are present."

stackTrace.description:
A stacktrace of the error that caused the {@link status} to be `FAILED`.
This field provides technical details on the underlying issue that resulted in the failure.
It is especially useful for debugging and identifying the exact line of code or operation that caused the failure.
The stack trace will be included only if the status is `FAILED`.

For example: "Error: Dataset has missing values in the feature 'age'. Stack trace: at prepareData (path/to/code:line)"

title:
This type defines the structure of a dataset preparation step within the `ReliabilityMl` module.
It is used to track the status of a dataset preparation process, including whether it succeeded,
a detailed message explaining the status, and a stack trace in case of failure.

The `ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationStep` type is typically used in the context of machine learning
pipelines or model training steps where the data needs to be prepared or pre-processed before further
use in training or inference. This type helps in tracking the progress and diagnosing any issues
that arise during the data preparation phase.
name: ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationStep
